Title: Senior Data Scientist - Pricing
Description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

About The Role

As part of the Bureau of Technology, you’ll design, build, and scale AI-driven solutions to improve our marketplace. You’ll join the Pricing & Quality team (a mix of data scientists and backend engineers) focused on curating offers to give customers the best value for money.

Your focus: implement models and algorithms to optimize fees and pricing.

What You’ll Do


Drive pricing intelligence: design and implement Machine Learning models and optimization algorithms that directly fuel a comprehensive suite of pricing levers
Own projects end to end: from problem definition and metrics design, through data extraction and model implementation, to presenting results to business and product stakeholders.
Collaborate with data scientists and backend engineers to translate models into production-ready features
Design and analyze experiments to measure the impact of fee strategies or model changes.
Leverage statistical analyses to uncover actionable insights and inform critical tech, business and product decisions
Communicate your work clearly to engineering, product, and business stakeholders.


About You


At least 5 years of industry experience as a data scientist and Master’s (or PhD ) in a quantitative discipline such as Statistics, Economics or Engineering
Impact-driven: You’ve contributed to data science projects that made a real impact on live, customer-facing products — not just in theory, but in production.
Comfortable with ambiguity: you are able to make decisions and propose directions even when the problem is not fully defined or the data is imperfect
Strong grasp of machine learning and statistical concepts and know how to choose the right model for the problem and make it work in a production environment.
Practical expertise in experimentation design and analysis.
Proficient in Python and SQL, and familiarity with software engineering principles around testing, code reviews, and deployment
Clear communicator: You are comfortable explaining complex ideas and results to diverse audiences, including senior management.
Experience in pricing, B2C marketplaces or revenue management is a strong plus.


Recruitment process


Call with one of our Tech recruiter (1h)
Technical screening (30 min)
Technical Interview (1h15)
Stakeholder interview (1h)
Meet your manager (30min)
Back Market Values fit interview (45 min)


WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

Benefits

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:


A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.
Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.
Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.


At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

Title: Senior Data Scientist - (Hybrid)
Description:
Senior Data Scientist (They/She/He) - (Hybrid)

As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

We're seeking an experienced Senior Data Scientist to join our team in Barcelona. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

You will have the opportunity to crunch massive datasets using the latest Big Data technologies as well as solve problems using state of the art AI algorithms. You will have the chance to debate and explore new ideas, approaches and technologies with your team to design and implement the best solutions. We follow the philosophy of using the right tool for the right job and are not afraid to explore the greenfield. You will be a key player in the organisation; designing and implementing advanced analytics and using machine learning to build AI powered solutions for almost every area in the business like online fraud detection, recommendation engines, user experience personalization, optimising the flight combinations we offer or the marketing campaigns we launch, and virtually every possible area subject to optimization in the business. Join us and help us reach our ambitious goal of becoming the global leader in online travel!

Within the Data Science team, we are focussed on researching and building cutting-edge solutions to evolve better travel experiences for our customers, all by leveraging the information from over 30 million searches that we receive everyday! Due to this scale, we are able to have a wider and better selection of travel plans that are tailored to suit the traveller’s needs which is probably more than any other travel site.. Machine learning models in production make over 1.8 Billion predictions a day improving customer experience and helping drive better decisions in an ever changing environment. The team is constantly evolving the next generation of models using cutting edge algorithms and technology to improve our goals to drive value for our customers.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

Join the world's leading travel subscription platform and one of the largest e-commerce businesses in Europe.


20 million customers – 44 markets – 5 brands – 6.5M members in Prime
16.2 million bookings FY23 - More than 50,000 bookings per day - 100 million daily user searches
8 Billion ML predictions per day - Up to 1.8 billion daily AI predictions[e1]
1400 employees – More than 50 different nationalities - 99% permanent contracts - 36.3 average age



We're a leading travel tech company, revolutionising the travel booking experience through our consumer insight, innovative technology, market leadership, and Prime, the world's first travel subscription program.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Senior Data Scientist in the Data Science team, you will be in charge of:


Work with multi-disciplinary teams and key stakeholders to drive value and growth for both our customers and business.
Take ownership of initiatives and ensure successful delivery from initiation to final outcome.
Provide transparency on initiatives to the team and stakeholders.
Influence and advice stakeholders on the best course of action.
Keep up-to-date on the advancements in the area of machine learning and AI.
Lead and mentor data scientists.
Act as an evangelist for machine learning and AI.
Adhere to company values, create and maintain a friendly working environment.



What you need to succeed:

Job Requirements

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:


Degree in a quantitative field (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Engineering or other quantitative fields);
5+ years of related experience as a Data Scientist, AI expert or Machine Learning engineer;
A solid understanding of relevant statistical, data processing and machine learning methods and their implementation using standard open source frameworks;
Experienced with building production ready machine learning solutions and MLOps;
Experienced Python developer. Other programming languages are a plus;
Experience with cloud platforms and scalable solutions;
Experience creating solutions powered by Generative AI, specially Large Language Models, and LLM frameworks like LangChain will be a plus;
Written and oral communication skills (in English).



What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture. Here's what we offer:


A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships.
Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
Grow opportunities to empower your career, and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome, not time-in-seat. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.



Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Our people are the key to our success. Each one of them is unique in their own way and the respect for their uniqueness is and will always be a passion and motivation.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
About BizAway

Here at BizAway, we Deliver the Future of Travel. 😎

We are a solid international company with strong ambitions and great expertise. With a focus on sustainability 🌱, on a daily basis we support companies enabling them to improve their travel management through our constantly evolving services and solutions, always characterized by our tech attitude and smart and innovative processes. 🚀

We know that success comes from People and deserves to be recognized.👫Proactivity and

Reliability, Kind collaboration, and communication are the core values of our Solution Culture.

If you like challenges and would love to be part of one of the fastest-growing B2B scale-ups, then BizAway is the company you have been looking for. 🤩

We are looking for

We are looking for a driven and enthusiastic Data Scientist (m/w/d) , who desires to contribute to the growth and success of our Data & Analytics Team.

Your role in BizAway


You design, build, and improve analytical and predictive solutions, from statistical models to reporting and dashboards, turning findings into clear, actionable insights through charts, graphs, and dashboards.
You learn all aspects of the travel industry from Finance, Products, Sales, and Service/Operations perspectives, translating data into actionable insights and verifiable reporting, and identifying opportunities where machine learning or automation can add value.
By developing domain expertise in our industry, you engage with Business and Strategy stakeholders to help define KPIs and metrics, including how data will be captured, shared, modeled, and leveraged across our departments.
You contribute to building the foundations of a comprehensive source of truth through data modeling, and you help prototype and operationalize data science use cases (e.g., forecasting, segmentation, recommendation).


Your Basic Qualifications


Previously worked in a Tech Company
Demonstrated experience with Python (or R) for data analysis and modeling
Working knowledge of core machine learning concepts and common libraries (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn)
Demonstrated experience with BI Data Visualization tools (Qlik preferred)
Data analysis, presentation, and visualization experience
Strong communication skills required
Ability to work alone or in a team as required
Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field is preferred
English proficiency (written and spoken, level B2)


We are also interested in


Exposure to ML deployment, MLOps, or cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)
Familiarity with generative AI / LLMs and their applied use cases
Experience working with large or unstructured datasets


Our offer

📄 Contract type: Permanent

🕓 Working hours: Full-time – 40h/week, from Monday to Friday

🏢 Hybrid setting, flexible working policy, and great offices in Europe

💰 Salary: Attractive compensation, including equity in the company

💼 Equity in the company (stock options plan)

✈️ A seat on a scale-up with skyrocketing growth

📈 Development of your entrepreneurial spirit, having the chance to implement real-impact business decision

🌍Multicultural and international team

🙌Collaborative and smart environment to work and learn

🍻Free coffee to kick-start your day and free beers to celebrate together

BizAway avoids any discrimination based on age, gender, sexual orientation, health status, nationality, political opinions, and religious beliefs in all decisions affecting personnel selection.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
¿Quiénes somos?

Somos una compañía tecnológica especializada en Inteligencia Artificial, IA Generativa, Analytics, Gobierno del Dato, Cloud y arquitecturas Event Driven, pero sobre todo somos un equipo con conocimiento, criterio y muchas ganas de hacer las cosas bien.

Trabajamos con talento altamente especializado, esté donde esté, y apostamos por una forma de crecer basada en la confianza, la autonomía y la participación. Nos mueve la excelencia tecnológica, la orientación a negocio y el sentido común, pero también el entusiasmo, la creatividad y la convicción de que la tecnología necesita alma, propósito y personas capaces de convertir la complejidad en soluciones reales.




¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos a un/a Data Scientist enfocado en forecasting de series temporales para el área de Finanzas con 2 años de experiencia en responsabilidades similares. Perfil con base técnica sólida - escribir buen código y manejarse con soltura en el desarrollo, aunque la productivización final se aborde en colaboración con Data Engineers.

Grado en Data Science, Informática, Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Estadística, Finanzas cuantitativas o afín (MS/PhD valorable).
Python sólido, con buenas prácticas de desarrollo (código limpio, testeado, versionado).
PySpark para procesamiento distribuido de datos a gran escala.
Experiencia demostrable en forecasting de series temporales (clásico y/o ML).
Aplicación de técnicas de ML sobre datasets grandes (clustering, clasificación, regresión, detección de anomalías).
SQL para acceso y transformación de datos.
Comprensión sólida de metodologías ágiles.
Inglés profesional.




Será un PLUS:

Dominio financiero (planificación, riesgo, FP&A, tesorería).
Tecnologías de bases de datos en cloud (p. ej. AWS) y despliegue en infraestructura cloud de datos/analítica.
Contenedores y pipelines/microservicios (Docker, Kubernetes).
Herramientas de dashboarding (Dash, Tableau).




¿Cómo será tu día a día?

Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener modelos de forecasting de series temporales (métodos estadísticos clásicos —ARIMA/SARIMA, suavizado exponencial, modelos de espacio de estados— y enfoques ML/probabilísticos) aplicados a problemáticas financieras.
Escribir código limpio, ordenado y bien documentado en Python, aplicando buenas prácticas (modularidad, pruebas, control de versiones) para que los modelos sean reproducibles y mantenibles.
Procesar y modelar datos a gran escala con PySpark, construyendo pipelines eficientes sobre datasets financieros voluminosos.
Crear modelos repetibles, interpretables, dinámicos y escalables, y colaborar con data engineers y leads de negocio en su integración en aplicaciones y herramientas.
Ingeniería de features combinando fuentes internas y externas para mejorar la precisión predictiva.
Apoyar la monitorización, mantenimiento y mejora de los modelos una vez en uso.
Comunicar el enfoque analítico (relevancia, trade-offs) a partners de negocio y traducir resultados a implicaciones financieras accionables.
Trabajar de forma iterativa e incremental en un equipo ágil cross-funcional, buscando mejorar velocidad y calidad sprint a sprint.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

Pertenecer a una empresa a la vanguardia tecnológica y centrada en las Personas, ponemos al trabajador en el centro de todo lo que hacemos. Creemos en una cultura horizontal, sin egos, en un entorno donde se valoran tanto las ideas como las personas.

Contrato indefinido y salario entre los 28.000 y 34.000 euros brutos/año de entrada, ajustado según tu experiencia (nuestro plan de carrera incluye 2 revisiones anuales). También tendrás a tu disposición un plan de formación especializado, participación en la propiedad y los beneficios de Mática: Wetaca gratuito en la oficina dos días a la semana, horario flexible con facilidades para trabajar desde donde quieras, seguro de salud, retribución flexible con Cobee, además de las vacaciones habituales, ofrecemos una semana extra en Navidad y tres días adicionales en Semana Santa.

También recibirás un divertido Welcome Kit con portátil (podrás escoger entre varios modelos Mac o Windows), móvil, botella personalizada, auriculares bluetooth y golosinas.

Cuando estés en nuestra oficina, en el centro de Barcelona o Madrid, la fruta, los cafés y los refrescos corren a cuenta de Mática. ¡Ah! Y si eres amante de los animales, te gustará saber esto: ¡nuestras oficinas son Pet-friendly!




Si te interesa, escríbenos por LinkedIn o envía tu CV a seleccion@maticapartners.com

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON​


Gameloft Barcelona is seeking a Data Scientist to join Gameloft Global Data team.

As a Data Scientist, you will be able to deep dive into our massive streams of player data in-game, prototype and deploy machine learning models to increase game revenue. You will help move projects from exploratory analysis to deployed models across live titles, including life-simulation and racing games.




What it means on a daily basis​


Analyse large-scale player data with Python and SQL, transforming it into clear, actionable insights.
Perform feature engineering on large-scale data from the data warehouse, managing your code with Git.
Prototype and improve machine learning models and prediction pipelines, using experimental design, causal inference, and A/B testing to raise performance baselines.
Present findings and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders across the game teams.


What success will look like​


In your first months, you will ramp up on our data infrastructure and deliver your first exploratory analyses.By the middle of your onboarding, you will be responsible for features or models end-to-end, framing problems clearly and presenting them to non-technical stakeholders. By the end of your onboarding, you will be conducting experiments and delivering improvements on your own, with your insights adopted across the game teams.


Who you will be working with


As a Data Scientist in our Global Data Science and Analytics team, you will be reporting to our Lead Data Scientist and collaborate very closely with other Data teams (Data Analyst, Data Engineering) and with our local Game teams. Our teams operate across multiple studios worldwide, including Paris, Barcelona, Montreal, Sofia, Bucharest, and others, offering opportunities to collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and perspectives.






Your recruitment journey​

First interview: An initial discussion to explore how the role aligns with your background and to address your main questions.​
Test: You will be given a case study to complete.​
Second interview: A technical interview focused on presenting your test and discussing your approach, reasoning, and methodologies in more depth.​
Final interview: A conversation to discuss your experience, vision, and how you approach data topics at a broader level.​


​Where this role can take you​


This role can be a stepping stone toward a more senior position, with the possibility of leading increasingly large and complex projects, so that your work shapes game performance and business results more widely over time.


WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED​


Proficient in Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Matplotlib, seaborn) and in SQL for large-scale data analysis.
Skilled in machine learning workflows, including experimental design, causal inference, and A/B testing.
Experienced with Git and comfortable working with large-scale data in a data warehouse environment.
Master's degree in a quantitative field (computer science, applied mathematics, data science, or related).


WHO YOU ARE​


Able to communicate and present to non-technical stakeholders in English, translating analytical work into clear, actionable recommendations.



WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU​





Permanent contract, full-time employment with comprehensive Social Benefits.
25 vacation days per year + Birthday day off.
Private medical health insurance.
Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card.
Free language courses.
Work-from-home hybrid model.
Merit based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.




Life at Gameloft


Our Barcelona studio offers real career development opportunities and a positive working environment in a centrally located office. We value supportive working conditions and a balanced work-life approach, and our teams work together with a collaborative mindset.



Ready to level up your career? Apply now with your CV in English.

Colaborar en el despliegue, seguimiento y mejora de los modelos.

Formación en Matemáticas, Estadística, Ciencia de Datos, Informática, Ingeniería o una disciplina relacionada.

Experiencia en análisis, limpieza, preparación y visualización de datos.

Conocimientos prácticos de estadística y machine learning.

Experiencia desarrollando modelos de regresión, clasificación o clustering.

Capacidad analítica, autonomía, motivación por aprender y facilidad para trabajar en equipo.

Spark o PySpark.

Plataformas como Microsoft Azure, Databricks, AWS o Google Cloud.

Desarrollo y despliegue de modelos en entornos cloud.

Entornos Linux e infraestructuras on-premise.

Docker, MLflow y prácticas básicas de MLOps.

Técnicas de forecasting y análisis de series temporales.

Modelos como Random Forest, XGBoost o LightGBM.

Deep learning con PyTorch o TensorFlow.

Inteligencia artificial generativa y LLM, incluyendo prompt engineering, RAG o fine-tuning.

Monitorización y mantenimiento de modelos en producción.

Title: Senior Data Scientist (Credit)
Description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

About the role:

At Moniepoint, data is at the core of everything we do. We are a customer-centric company, and your work will enable our teams to make informed, data-driven decisions that directly impact the success of our business. We are seeking a data-driven, impact-oriented Senior Data Scientist to power Moniepoint’s consumer lending decisions at scale. You will build the models, experiments, and insights that shape how we acquire, underwrite, and retain millions of customers across Nigeria and Africa.

This role is pivotal in driving our pricing, credit limit modelling, and credit model deployment strategy in a growing business with unparalleled opportunities to give access to millions of customers. You’ll collaborate with our amazing Consumer Credit team and drive how we think about risk ranking, product offering, and data infrastructure to create the best personalised offers for our customers. You’ll be responsible for building our first suite of credit risk models and help drive a culture of how we should think about machine learning vs more traditional methods - bringing fresh thinking to inspire both the team and our customers.

Sitting at the intersection of data science, credit risk, and product, you’ll translate complex data into actionable decisions that drive growth with healthy portfolio performance.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

What You’ll Do


Develop and deploy credit scoring, affordability, and behavioural models to support underwriting, pricing, and collections
Design and run experiments to optimise approval rates, loss rates, and profitability
Partner with product squads to embed decision logic into real-time systems
Ensure data quality, compliance, and ethical use of models across all decisioning processes
Mentor product squads on best practices in experimentation and data-driven decision making
Provide models to optimise outcomes in collections, churn management and user retention


We would love to hear from you if…


You’re comfortable with Statistics - and have a Degree or qualifications in a quantitative field (Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or similar)
You have +5 years of experience in data science, decision science, or risk analytics within financial services
Working knowledge of credit risk, consumer lending, and regulatory considerations
Proficiency in SQL and at least one modelling/programming language (Python, R)
Experience with A/B testing, machine learning, collections modelling and churn management
Ability to translate complex analyses into clear recommendations for business stakeholders
High ownership mindset and comfort working in fast-paced, cross-functional teams


What we can offer you


Culture: We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
Learning: We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
Compensation: You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, monthly bonuses, plus other benefits


What to expect in the hiring process


A preliminary phone call with the recruiter
A coding exercise on HackerRank - covering core data science theory (math, statistics, linear algebra) and Python fundamentals (data structures & algorithms).
A take-home assignment
A technical interview with a Lead in our Data Science Team to review your take-home assignment in depth
A behavioural and technical interview with the hiring manager


Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

Title: Senior Data Scientist, Commerce Analytics & Insights
Description:
What You'll Do:

We are looking for a senior, strategic, and hands-on Data Scientist to lead the data and methodological backbone of Commerce Analytics and Commerce Insights at Criteo. This person will own the analytical rigor behind the work: building and improving pipelines, understanding source tables and data dependencies, ensuring reliable execution, and defining or validating the methodologies behind key metrics and outputs.

This role is not only about producing analyses. It is about creating trusted, scalable analytical foundations for Commerce Analytics and Insights, while staying close enough to business context to ensure the work remains relevant and useful.

Success in this role means pipelines and analytical workflows are reliable, maintainable, and trusted; metrics are clearly defined, methodologically sound, and consistently applied; and analytical outputs are accurate and resilient enough for repeated commercial use. Data dependencies, assumptions, and limitations should be documented and understood, while manual analytical work should decrease over time as scalable solutions are introduced.

This role is not the primary owner of client orchestration or commercial project leadership. Its center of gravity is data execution, methodological rigor, and scalable analytical foundations.

What You'll Do


Own the data-science and analytical execution layer of Commerce Analytics and Commerce Insights
Build, improve, and maintain data pipelines that power recurring analytics and insightgeneration
Develop deep understanding of source tables, data lineage, business logic, and data qualityrisks
Ensure analytical outputs are correct, consistent, and operationally reliable
Define, document, challenge, and improve methodologies behind key metrics, cuts, andanalytical frameworks
Partner with Solution Architect and commercial stakeholders to translate business questionsinto robust analytical approaches
Drive the hands-on execution of analyses across commerce analytics and commerce insightsuse cases
Create scalable approaches rather than one-off manual work whenever possible
Investigate data issues, edge cases, or inconsistencies and resolve them with strongownership
Contribute to documentation, process improvement, and knowledge transfer so that work canscale beyond one individual
Help identify where automation, standardization, or better data design can improve quality and speed
Stay close to business context so that technical execution remains aligned with client and program needs



Who You Are:


Senior and hands-on, with strong ownership of both execution and quality
Deeply comfortable with data engineering and pipelines, analytical logic, and metric design
Strong SQL, Python, spark and strong coding skills for data processing and workflowdevelopment
Experience building production-grade or near-production analytical pipelines
Experience documenting methods and educating stakeholders on metric definitions and analytical caveats is a plus
Able to understand what tables mean, how they connect, and where business interpretation can go wrong
Methodologically rigorous, with strong judgment on how to define and validate metrics
Structured and practical: you can move from ambiguous business questions to executable analytical solutions
Comfortable collaborating with client-facing and non-technical stakeholders, even if this is not the center of gravity of the role
Strategic enough to improve the system, not just execute within it
Significant experience in data science, analytics engineering, analytical product work, or a similar role in a data-rich environment
Strong understanding of experimentation, metrics, methodology design, and analytical QA
Experience working with large-scale behavioral, commerce, or media datasets



We acknowledge that many candidates may not meet every single role requirement listed above. If your experience looks a little different from our requirements but you believe that you can still bring value to the role, we’d love to see your application!

Who We Are:

We’re Criteo, the Commerce Intelligence Platform. Criteo helps businesses turn shopper signals into commerce outcomes while delivering more relevant experiences for shoppers. We use proprietary commerce intelligence and AI decisioning to drive relevance for shoppers and performance for businesses.

At Criteo, our culture is as unique as it is diverse. From our offices across the globe or from the comfort of home, our 3,600 Criteos collaborate together to build an open, impactful, and forward-thinking environment.

We foster a workplace where everyone is valued, and employment decisions are based solely on skills, qualifications, and business needs—never on non-job-related factors or legally protected characteristics.

What We Offer:

🏢 Ways of working – Our hybrid model blends home with in-office experiences, making space for both.

📈 Grow with us – Learning, mentorship & career development programs.

💪 Your wellbeing matters – Health benefits, wellness perks & mental health support.

🤝 A team that cares – Diverse, inclusive, and globally connected.

💸 Fair pay & perks – Attractive salary, with performance-based rewards and family-friendly policies, plus the potential for equity depending on role and level.

Additional benefits may vary depending on the country where you work and the nature of your employment with Criteo.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Descripció de l'empresa




Dribia som un estudi d’innovació en ciència de dades: dissenyem algoritmes d’optimització i predicció a partir de la detecció de patrons en les dades. Despleguem els nostres algoritmes per crear solucions de software a mida basades en analítica avançada de dades i intel·ligència artificial.

Som un equip amb experiència, creatiu i potent tècnicament. Combinem una contrastada trajectòria en consultoria privada en ciència de dades amb una sòlida formació acadèmica. Hem executat projectes per empreses de diversos sectors que inclouen: previsió de vendes, optimització de processos, recomanació de productes, previsió de fugues de clients o anàlisi del llenguatge natural entre d’altres.

Aquest talent el canalitzem a través d’una metodologia àgil pròpia, específica per a projectes de dades i àmpliament validada. Lliurem solucions completes end-to-end basades en codi obert, documentat i totalment transferible als nostres clients (sense restriccions d'IP i llicències). A més, proveïm del suport necessari perquè el client pugui integrar i operar amb les solucions lliurades autònomament




Descripció de tasques




Projecte amb client

Els equips en un projecte de desenvolupament estàndard consisteix en un equip de dedicació total 1.4 FTE1. Aquest equip està liderat per un responsable de Projecte (RP) al 40%, un o dos desenvolupadors principals (Dev), amb un total de dedicació del 100%, i un possible suport amb dedicació variable. Aquesta dedicació pot variar en funció de

l’experiència del científic de dades, dels requisits del client i de les particularitats del projecte. En general l’activitat de projecte es duu a terme a les oficines de Dribia (o en remot) i, si les condicions ho permeten, les presentacions de final d’sprint es duen a terme a les oficines del client (1 dia cada dues setmanes).

A Dribia som conscients que la creativitat requereix diàleg i perspectiva. En aquesta línia, a part de l'equip amb dedicació intensiva en el projecte, setmanalment organitzem seminaris de discussió sobre els projectes actius, on l'equip de Dribia al complet contribueix al disseny i resolució de problemes.




Projectes de manteniment i millores

A Dribia participem de tot el cicle de vida dels projectes i, per tant, un cop entreguem les nostres solucions, també ens encarreguem del seguiment, resolució d’incidències i millores. Aquestes tasques poden estar articulades per bossa d’hores o per una dedicació constant. Sigui quina sigui la fórmula, trimestralment obliguem el client a dedicar les hores no utilitzades en millores incrementals de la solució i, per tant, afegint una part més creativa al

manteniment típic de solucions desplegades.




Projectes interns

Sempre que algú tingui disponibilitat, incentivem la dedicació en la millora d’eines internes: desenvolupament de solucions pròpies, llibreries pròpies, snippets de codi, documentació interna, etc. Si es considera oportú, aquestes eines es poden alliberar i publicar en llicències de codi obert. La metodologia de treball en els projectes interns serà la més similar possible a la feta servir amb els clients. Iterativa i entregables cada 2 setmanes.




Redacció de propostes.

Els científics de dades Sènior poden donar suport a l’equip comercial en la redacció de propostes sobretot en la definició de la solució algorítmica i planificació, així com la dedicació aproximada per a cada una de les fases. No s’envia cap proposta comercial a un client sense l’acord de l’equip de projecte proposat. Si es requereix una defensa presencial de la proposta, hi participa tot l’equip, on cada u es presentarà i el responsable del projecte defensarà la part tècnica i planificació del projecte.




Desenvolupament d’eines internes i formació

Incentivem preparar i dur a terme sessions de formació interna per tal de difondre les noves eines desenvolupades, coneixements que es creguin rellevants o compartir reptes dels projectes. Aquestes sessions les anomenem Pizza Slides i es duen a terme cada un o dos divendres a les oficines abans de dinar (dinar a càrrec de Dribia).




Requisits dels candidats

Llicenciatura o grau amb un alt contingut en matemàtiques i estadística (per exemple física o matemàtiques) amb experiència en desenvolupament de programari en Python. Els coneixements en algorítmia i/o intel·ligència artificial són desitjables però no imprescindibles. Per sobre de tot valorem el talent, la comunicació, la creativitat, i

l’organització.

Data Scientist Júnior

Grau + mínim de 2 anys d’experiència en programació.

Data Scientist

Experiència de 4 anys en programació (sigui màster o laboral) o un doctorat amb ús intensiu de l’estadística i la programació.

Sènior Data Scientist

Experiència de 6 anys en programació i experiència laboral de 3 anys en el sector privat de les ciències de dades.

Mànager Data Scientist

Experiència mínima de 2 anys com a Sènior Data scientist a Dribia.

Title: Principal Data Scientist, Generative Recommendations & AI- Spain Remote
Description:
Location: Spain,

Experience: 8+ Years building and deploying machine learning models and llms into high-scale customer experiences

Stack: Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, SQL, Databricks, Snowflake.

Our Team

At Vista Engineering, we are building an industry-leading Customer Relevance Platform to scale personalization across products, design templates, and marketing messages. We are moving away from "model sprawl" toward a unified architecture centered on fmX, a foundation model that learns shared embeddings for all relevant entities for vistaprint (users, products, marketing message, templates…etc.).

Our FY27 mission is focused on delivering an "Context-aware Customer Experience". To achieve this, we are prioritizing the evolution of Intent-Based Personalization—capturing real-time journey signals to match the customer's immediate goals—and infusing our recommendations into Agentic experiences, equipping AI assistants with the context needed to drive conversational shopping.

What You Will Do

As the Principal Data Scientist, you will drive the generative and context-aware evolution of our platform. Part of this role involves partnering directly with another Principal Data Scientist to co-lead our research agenda, accelerate our strategic progress, and elevate the overall capabilities of the Data Science team. You will research, design, and evangelize how Vista uses Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) to go beyond traditional retrieval and ranking, creating fully contextualized, ML-driven customer experiences.

Generative, Intent-Based & Agentic Recommendations


Lead the evolution of our recommendation systems into the Generative AI era, moving our architecture beyond static item retrieval by researching generative recommendation paradigms (e.g., agentic recommendations, contextual narratives).
Develop an algorithmic intent layer that translates real-time browsing signals into actionable customer intents that will inform our recommendations.
Architect the ML pathways to expose core recommendation actions as tools for AI agents, allowing them to synthesize customer intent, retrieve/rank candidates from fmX, and power seamless conversational shopping experiences.


Broad Personalization Strategy & Segmentation


Build advanced propensity models and leverage foundational customer traits to drive customer segmentations and personas.
Ensure these segmentations are actionable and strategically aligned to the company strategy.


ML-Driven Bot Detection


Tackle the critical bot traffic challenge by building multi-layered, hybrid machine learning models trained on historical web tracking data.
Classify ambiguous sessions that bypass deterministic rules to protect our analytics and personalization integrity.


Data Science Leadership & Evangelization


Partner closely with our existing Principal Data Scientist to divide and conquer complex research initiatives, accelerating the overall team's output and maturity.
Act as the primary AI ambassador across Vista, influencing product, engineering, and business leadership to embrace a model-driven approach.
Work closely with platform and experience teams to ensure that ML models integrate seamlessly into the customer experience without degrading Core Web Vitals or caching efficiency.


Your Qualifications

At VistaPrint, we are striving to hire individuals that add new ideas and perspectives to our teams and enhance our culture. No matter your background or work experience, we strongly encourage you to apply—even if you feel that you don’t meet the exact requirements or have the same qualifications. You might be a great candidate for this or other opportunities.


Advanced degree (Ph.D. or Master's) in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or a closely related quantitative field.
8+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning models into high-scale customer experiences.
Deep expertise in Deep Learning, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Reinforcement Learning.
Proven track record of building robust propensity models, customer segmentation frameworks, and anomaly/bot detection algorithms on large-scale behavioral data.
Expert-level proficiency in Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, and SQL.
Strong architectural understanding of how ML models interact with both backend data pipelines (e.g., streaming features, Databricks, Snowflake) and frontend delivery systems (e.g., UI fragment rendering, caching strategies).
Very strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Proven ability to translate complex statistical and algorithmic concepts into clear business value to influence non-technical leadership.
Relevant work experience in an Agile environment and in the e-commerce or marketing domain.


Why You'll Love Working Here

There is a lot to love about working at VistaPrint. We are an award winning Remote-First company. We’re an inclusive community. We’re growing (which means you can too). And to help orient us all in the same direction, we have our Vista Behaviors which exemplify the behavioral attributes that make us a culturally strong and high-performing team.

About Us

VistaPrint is the design and marketing partner to millions of small businesses around the world. Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
En Mango vestimos de pasión todo lo que hacemos. Con origen en Barcelona y presencia en más de 120 países, inspiramos al mundo con creatividad, innovación y autenticidad.

Nuestro equipo multicultural es el motor de nuestro éxito. Nos enorgullece llevar la moda más allá, conectando nuestro estilo único con personas de todo el mundo.

En MANGO, estamos comprometidos en convertirnos en una empresa impulsada por datos y estamos formando un equipo de Data y Advanced Analytics compuesto por más de 50 profesionales. Este equipo incluye perfiles como ML Engineers, Data Scientists, Big Data Engineers y Software Engineers, con el objetivo de desarrollar plataformas de vanguardia. Estas plataformas permitirán a nuestros squads analíticos crear soluciones innovadoras basadas en Inteligencia Artificial.

El equipo de Advanced Analytics está compuesto por el squad de IA generativa centrado en iniciativas con algoritmos generativos y en el desarrollo de una plataforma interna basada en LLM. El squad de personalización, que crea algoritmos para ofrecer experiencias personalizadas y recomendaciones de productos en tiempo real en mango.com; el squad de Pricing, que optimiza promociones y descuentos para mejorar el margen de la compañía. Y finalmente, el squad de Producto se focaliza en mejorar las decisiones en los primeros pasos de la creación de la colección.

Para este último squad, estamos buscando un/a Senior Data Scientist, preferiblemente con experiencia en el sector retail-fashion para trabajar en proyectos como la optimización de las cantidades de compra para nuevas colecciones, el assortment planning (donde se optimiza la asignación de productos a tiendas), la optimización de las últimas unidades de stock online para su venta en las tiendas más rentables, y un asistente basado en IA generativa para crear reportes y obtener recomendaciones de acciones. Además, el equipo ya tiene en producción proyectos como la anticipación de best-sellers, la predicción de ventas y demanda (incluyendo roturas de stock) y el etiquetado automático de características de prenda mediante técnicas de computer vision y procesamiento de lenguaje natural.

Todos los proyectos se desarrollan en la nube de AWS utilizando una variedad de herramientas y servicios avanzados. Entre ellos se incluyen Amazon S3 para almacenamiento, AWS Lambda para computación sin servidor, y diversas APIs para la integración de servicios. Además, empleamos Apache Airflow para la orquestación y programación de flujos de trabajo, y Amazon Elastic Container Registry (ECR) para la gestión de contenedores y Jenkins para su despliegue. Utilizamos MongoDB como nuestra base de datos NoSQL y Databricks para nuestro Datalake.

TU NUEVO PUESTO

Como Senior Data Scientist especializado/a en retail-fashion formarás parte del equipo que trabaja en la investigación, definición, prototipado, desarrollo y puesta en producción de soluciones basadas en algorítmica de IA.

En tu día a día…


Entenderás los problemas/dificultades que se encuentran los diferentes departamentos de planificación, compras, distribución, etc.
Desarrollarás pruebas de concepto rápidas con herramientas como Streamlit, entendiendo la calidad y el potencial de los datos disponibles y/o necesarios, extrayendo conocimiento relevante que permita preparar un posible proyecto futuro con métricas de ROI asociadas.
Redactarás statements of work básicos de proyectos con todas las partes implicadas.
Desarrollarás proyectos basados en algoritmos de Machine Learning en entornos de producción.
Colaborarás con otros Data Scientists, ML Engineers y miembros del equipo de Advanced Analytics para la correcta implementación de soluciones.
Utilizarás tecnologías Big Data para manejar grandes volúmenes de datos y mejorar la eficiencia de los modelos.


SOBRE TÍ


Grado/Máster en Ing. Informática, Ing. Ciencia de Datos, o similar.
Al menos 5 años de experiencia desarrollando en Python u otro lenguaje orientado a objetos.
Experiencia en el uso y puesta en producción de librerías enfocadas a Deep Learning como TensorFlow o PyTorch.
Sólidos conocimientos en Machine Learning y redes neuronales. Arquitecturas y métodos de evaluación.
Experiencia en prototipar soluciones software basadas en Machine Learning y capacidad para definir la experimentación necesaria en este tipo de proyectos. Se valora positivamente haber liderado el desarrollo end-to-end de un proyecto desde la fase de prototipo hasta la puesta en producción y mantenimiento.
Se valora muy positivamente el conocimiento en buenas prácticas de programación y desarrollo de software: tests, automatizaciones, pipelines en CI (Jenkins), etc.
Se valora haber trabajado con servicios cloud mencionados anteriormente.
Persona comprometida, proactiva, curiosa, con ganas de innovar y una mentalidad hands-on.


TUS BENEFICIOS


Incorporación inmediata con contrato indefinido.
Ofrecemos horario flexible (puedes entrar de 8 a 9.30 y salir de 17 a 18.30) con jornada intensiva todos los viernes (puedes entrar de 8 a 9 y salir de 14 a 15) y la mayoría de las vigilias de festivos
Nuestras oficinas se encuentran en Palau- Solita i Plegamans.
Posibilidad de teletrabajo en un 50%.
35% de descuento en todas nuestras líneas.
Te podrás formar a nivel técnico en plataformas como Udemy, entre otras, así como en idiomas, y en habilidades para tu desarrollo personal. ¡Te acompañamos para que sigas creciendo a nivel profesional y personal!
Política de referrals, podrás participar en la incorporación de talento a nuestros equipos, ¡y te recompensaremos por ello!
Transporte gratuito de empresa desde Barcelona y el Vallès para llegar a nuestras oficinas centrales
Sala de fitness y vestuarios por si te gusta hacer deporte en tu tiempo libre
Workshops, meetups, comunidades de prácticas, team buildings y company meetings
Paquete de retribución flexible con ventajas fiscales: seguro médico, formación, descuento comedor, guarderías etc
Servicio de comedor y cocina en las instalaciones de la central. La empresa subvenciona parte del menú diario, así como los artículos de cafetería.
Servicio médico propio en las instalaciones de la central.
Formarás parte de una empresa líder en el sector de la moda, dinámica, en plena innovación, con gran concienciación y realizando acciones hacia la sostenibilidad
Ambiente de trabajo cercano, inspirador y ambicioso, trabajarás con un gran equipo que va en la misma dirección para conseguir los mejores resultados
Oportunidades constantes de desarrollo con retos muy variados que generan aprendizaje en el puesto de trabajo

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Data Scientist — Machine Learning for Marketing 📍 Barcelona · Full-time




Most marketing decisions are still made on instinct. We help the world's most sophisticated advertisers replace that instinct with evidence.




Indaru is an independent media and data advisory firm. We combine senior consulting judgement with advanced analytics to answer the questions that matter most to large advertisers: what is our marketing actually delivering, what should we change, and what happens if we do? Our work sits behind multi-million-euro investment decisions at some of the largest brands in the world.




We're looking for a Data Scientist who is genuinely excited about applying machine learning to real commercial problems — and who wants their models to shape decisions, not sit in a notebook.




What you'll work on You'll join a team of data scientists building the models and measurement that guide our clients' marketing investment. Day to day, that means:

Developing machine-learning models applied to marketing — Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), forecasting, segmentation and attribution
Contributing to our proprietary products: AITA, our MMM platform, and EcoMetrics, our ISO-aligned solution for measuring the carbon footprint of digital advertising
Turning model output into clear, defensible recommendations clients can act on
Building and optimising the data pipelines (ELT) that bring together Google Ads, Meta, Google Analytics, YouTube and Amazon data
Designing and maintaining dashboards in Looker Studio, Shiny, Power BI and similar tools
Presenting your findings directly to clients — your analysis, in your words




What we're looking for

Essential

Strong Python for data science (pandas, scikit-learn and the wider ecosystem) and comfort working with large datasets (GB–TB scale)
Solid SQL — able to write and reason about complex queries
A rigorous, detail-oriented and self-directed way of working
A genuine collaborator who enjoys working closely with colleagues and clients
Strong written and spoken English (C1)
A degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or a related quantitative field

Nice to have

Experience with deep-learning or Bayesian frameworks (TensorFlow, Keras, PyMC, PySpark)
Familiarity with a cloud platform (Google Cloud, AWS or Azure)
Exposure to marketing, media or advertising data
Additional languages — we work across Europe, the Americas, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific




Don't tick every box? If you're strong on the essentials and keen to grow into the rest, we'd still like to hear from you.




What we offer

A front-row seat on high-stakes measurement work for global brands — exposure most data scientists wait years for
Proprietary products at the frontier of MMM and sustainability measurement
Real ownership of your work and direct client contact early on
A serious commitment to developing your potential — we treat growth as part of the job, not a perk
A collaborative, open team that takes the work seriously without taking itself too seriously
Full-time position based in Barcelona, with a competitive salary

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
As one of our Games Data Scientists you will be the business facing masterminds who help turn business questions into actionable insights. You research and analyze player behaviour, and come up with recommendations. Data Scientists do this by listening to team members, understanding context and challenging business ideas. Data Scientists use diverse techniques - frequentist and Bayesian statistics, machine learning, exploratory and explanatory data analysis, causal inference, data visualization, monte carlo modelling, econometric analysis, etc. Such broad requirements call for the ability to learn quickly, work efficiently with peers and communicate data clearly and effectively. Games Data Scientists are true visionaries who support business decisions with data and in-depth analytics.

You will have the opportunity to work with large and complex data sets, with the autonomy to make a huge impact on the success of our games. You will also be working as part of an experienced and highly skilled team of 20 with opportunities to learn and develop.

What You'll Do
Discuss with stakeholders requirements for analysis
Run exploratory data analysis and turn it into questions which can be answered with analytical techniques
Use simple analytics, statistical or causal inference, machine learning or any other techniques to answer questions and address problems
Communicate results clearly and effectively
Take care of unclear and ambiguous requirements
Communicate complex ideas and analyses in a simple way
Work independently on complex projects
Be willing to acquire new skills and learn new methodologies, whether related to stakeholder management, communication or data science
Be able to use diverse data science tools and approaches


What We're Looking For
A degree or equivalent work experience in data driven field
Ability to use visualization techniques for communicating data and analysis
Experience of using any of the following to answer business or scientific questions -statistics, mathematics, machine learning, econometrics, causal techniques, monte carlo modelling, etc.
R/Python experience
Knowledge and experience of SQL


Why Product Madness?

As part of the Aristocrat family, we share their mission of bringing joy to life through the power of play, with a world-class team who creates top-grossing, leading titles in the social casino genre, including Heart of Vegas, Lightning Link, Cashman Casino. With 800 team members across the globe, Product Madness is headquartered in London, with offices in Barcelona, Gdańsk, Lviv, Montreal and a remote team spanning the USA, making us a truly global powerhouse.

We live by our People First principle. Regardless of where, when, or how they work, our team members have opportunities to elevate their careers, and grow alongside us. We take pride in fostering an inclusive culture, where our people are encouraged to be their very best, every day. But don’t just take our word for it. In 2024, we made the Global Inspiring Workplace Awards list, and won a bronze award at the Stevies for Great Employers in the ‘Employer of the Year - Media and Entertainment’ category.

So, what’s stopping you?

Travel Expectations

None

Additional Information

At this time, we are unable to sponsor work visas for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the job posting location for this position on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship.

Compensation Philosophy

We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Data Scientists use diverse techniques - frequentist and Bayesian statistics, machine learning, exploratory and explanatory data analysis, causal inference, data visualization, monte carlo modelling, econometric analysis, etc. Such broad requirements call for the ability to learn quickly, work efficiently with peers and communicate data clearly and effectively. Games Data Scientists are true visionaries who support business decisions with data and in-depth analytics.

You will have the opportunity to work with large and complex data sets, with the autonomy to make a huge impact on the success of our games. You will also be working as part of an experienced and highly skilled team of 20 with opportunities to learn and develop.

  • Discuss with stakeholders requirements for analysis
  • Run exploratory data analysis and turn it into questions which can be answered with analytical techniques
  • Use simple analytics, statistical or causal inference, machine learning or any other techniques to answer questions and address problems
  • Communicate results clearly and effectively
  • Take care of unclear and ambiguous requirements
  • Communicate complex ideas and analyses in a simple way
  • Work independently on complex projects
  • Be willing to acquire new skills and learn new methodologies, whether related to stakeholder management, communication or data science
  • Be able to use diverse data science tools and approaches

What We're Looking For
  • A degree or equivalent work experience in data driven field
  • Ability to use visualization techniques for communicating data and analysis
  • Experience of using any of the following to answer business or scientific questions -statistics, mathematics, machine learning, econometrics, causal techniques, monte carlo modelling, etc.
  • R/Python experience
  • Knowledge and experience of SQL

Why Product Madness?

As part of the Aristocrat family, we share their mission of bringing joy to life through the power of play, with a world-class team who creates top-grossing, leading titles in the social casino genre, including Heart of Vegas, Lightning Link, Cashman Casino. With 800 team members across the globe, Product Madness is headquartered in London, with offices in Barcelona, Gdańsk, Lviv, Montreal and a remote team spanning the USA, making us a truly global powerhouse.

We live by our People First principle. Regardless of where, when, or how they work, our team members have opportunities to elevate their careers, and grow alongside us. We take pride in fostering an inclusive culture, where our people are encouraged to be their very best, every day. But don’t just take our word for it. In 2024, we made the Global Inspiring Workplace Awards list, and won a bronze award at the Stevies for Great Employers in the ‘Employer of the Year - Media and Entertainment’ category.

So, what’s stopping you?

Travel Expectations

None

Additional Information

We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
ABOUT US

In more than ten countries around the world, The Knot Worldwide champions the power of celebration. Our global family of brands provide best-in-class products, services and content to take celebration planning from inspiration to action. At the core of our business is our industry-leading global online wedding Vendor Marketplace, connecting couples with local wedding professionals and a comprehensive suite of personalized wedding websites, planning tools, invitations, and registry services that make wedding planning easier for couples around the globe. Each year, we connect more than 4.5 million users with around 900,000 global small businesses through our Vendor Marketplace.

LIFE AT TKWW

At The Knot Worldwide, we believe in doing work that matters. Each year, we help millions of couples around the world celebrate life’s most meaningful moments, while also helping hundreds of thousands of global small business owners get discovered and scale. Life here means working alongside a team that cares deeply, not just about the work you do, but about the life you live. We prioritize employee well-being and development through meaningful opportunities for growth, and we celebrate milestones and wins in a big way. After all, celebrations are what we do best.

ABOUT THE ROLE AND OUR TEAM:

TKWW is looking for a Senior  Data Scientist to join our team of data professionals supporting our Marketplace. The Senior  Data Scientist will play a critical role in shaping data strategy, guiding experimentation, and driving impact through advanced analytics. They will partner with cross-functional teams—including product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders—to design experiments, develop analytical tools, and ensure we are making data-driven decisions that deliver measurable results. As a trusted advisor and mentor, this person will both lead analyses directly and elevate the work of the broader team.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Gather, analyze, and interpret data to deliver business impact and help the organization make informed decisions
Apply advanced statistical and machine learning techniques (e.g., hypothesis testing, regression, classification, clustering, forecasting, causal inference) to uncover insights and guide strategy
Forecast and simulate hypotheticals to provide early potential signals before large initiatives start
Design and analyze A/B and multivariate testing experiments; guide experimentation best practices across teams
Design, build, and maintain reusable, scalable data products and self-serve capabilities used by multiple internal teams
Translate analyses into clear, actionable recommendations, linking insights to business outcomes such as ROI, conversion, retention, and revenue
Maintain a deep understanding of the product, relevant data assets, and the outcomes of past experiments and analyses
Identify opportunities for new data products and integrations, prioritize a backlog of data assets and use cases, and collaborate with business partners to implement them
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and other stakeholders to ensure strong internal customer focus and alignment
Partner with engineers to ensure appropriate and scalable tracking is in place

 

REQUIREMENTS:
Excellent communication skills; able to translate technical concepts to non-technical audiences
Strong business acumen and ability to translate business problems into analytical solutions and decision frameworks
Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment through data-driven insights and recommendations
Advanced knowledge of statistics, including hypothesis testing, regression, causal inference, and forecasting
Hands-on experience with experiment design, analysis, and rollout of A/B and multivariate tests
Advanced SQL skills and ability to write efficient, production-ready queries
Strong Python skills for data manipulation, visualization, and advanced analysis
Knowledge of data modeling and experience partnering with engineers on data infrastructure
Experience prioritizing and managing analytical work, data assets, or product backlogs in a cross-functional environment
Master’s or Ph.D. in a quantitative field preferred
2+ years of experience in data science or advanced analytics, with some prior leadership, mentorship, or project ownership experience
Fluent in English & Spanish  

WORK MODEL:

This role is Together@TKWW-eligible and based near one of our office hubs. You’ll be expected to work in the office two days a week as part of our hybrid work model.

 

  

#professional 

AI FLUENCY

At TKWW, AI is a tool that helps our teams work smarter, move faster, and spend more time on the work that matters most. We expect every employee, in every role, to build fluency with the AI tools relevant to their work, use them thoughtfully and with sound judgment, and bring curiosity as these tools keep evolving. This isn't about replacing our people's expertise — it's about equipping every employee to use AI to raise the bar on the work we do together.

WHAT WE LOVE ABOUT YOU:

Commit to our customers: You act as one team on behalf of our customers. You lead with head and heart, and build what matters for life's most meaningful moments.
Raise the bar: You define "great" and work backwards. You don't just accept how it's been done, but boldly define how it should be. You are unafraid to innovate, learn, and keep moving forward toward our shared vision.
Be all in: You believe in our mission and take ownership of your work. You debate openly to reach the best outcomes, speaking with clarity and care, embracing diverse perspectives, then commit fully.
Celebrate impact: You measure success by the outcomes you create. You hold yourself accountable to delivering value, while recognizing progress and the lessons learned along the way.  You love to win, together.

WHAT YOU LOVE ABOUT US:

We provide meaningful, high-impact benefits designed to support the holistic well-being of our diverse workforce and help our people thrive both professionally and personally. From physical and mental wellness to flexible time off our programs are built around the moments that matter most.

TOGETHER@TKWW: OUR APPROCH TO HYBRID WORK

Together@TKWW is designed to support how we work best: combining the flexibility we value with meaningful opportunities to connect in person. Whether a role is Together@TKWW-eligible or not, we believe in purposeful moments to come together, build strong relationships, and drive bold ideas forward.
For Together@TKWW-eligible roles, this includes regular in-office time to foster collaboration and connection.
For roles not eligible for in-office expectations, we support connection through virtual collaboration and intentional gatherings.

To facilitate in-person collaboration, we have office spaces in Barcelona, Spain; Delhi, India; Galway, Ireland; London, England and New York, NY.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Como uno de nuestros Data Scientists de Juegos

Serás una de las personas clave que ayuda a transformar preguntas de negocio en insights accionables. Investigarás y analizarás el comportamiento de los jugadores para generar recomendaciones basadas en datos. Para ello, escucharás a los distintos miembros del equipo, comprenderás el contexto y cuestionarás ideas de negocio cuando sea necesario.

Nuestros Data Scientists utilizan una amplia variedad de técnicas, como estadística frecuentista y bayesiana, machine learning, análisis exploratorio y explicativo de datos, inferencia causal, visualización de datos, modelización Monte Carlo, análisis econométrico, entre otras. La amplitud de estas responsabilidades requiere una gran capacidad de aprendizaje, eficiencia en el trabajo colaborativo y habilidad para comunicar datos e insights de forma clara y efectiva.

Los Data Scientists de Juegos son profesionales que impulsan la toma de decisiones de negocio mediante el uso de datos y análisis profundos.

Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar con conjuntos de datos grandes y complejos, disfrutando de la autonomía necesaria para generar un impacto significativo en el éxito de nuestros juegos. Además, formarás parte de un equipo experimentado y altamente cualificado de aproximadamente 20 profesionales, con múltiples oportunidades de aprendizaje y desarrollo.

Qué harás


Colaborar con los stakeholders para entender y definir los requisitos de análisis.
Realizar análisis exploratorios de datos y convertir los hallazgos en preguntas que puedan responderse mediante técnicas analíticas.
Utilizar analítica avanzada, métodos estadísticos, inferencia causal, machine learning u otras técnicas para responder preguntas y resolver problemas de negocio.
Comunicar los resultados de forma clara y efectiva.
Gestionar requisitos poco definidos o ambiguos.
Explicar análisis complejos e ideas técnicas de manera sencilla y comprensible.
Trabajar de forma autónoma en proyectos complejos.
Mantener una actitud de aprendizaje continuo, adquiriendo nuevas habilidades y metodologías relacionadas con la ciencia de datos, la comunicación o la gestión de stakeholders.
Utilizar una amplia variedad de herramientas y enfoques de ciencia de datos.


Qué buscamos


Titulación universitaria o experiencia equivalente en un área orientada a los datos.
Capacidad para utilizar técnicas de visualización de datos con el fin de comunicar análisis e insights de manera efectiva.
Experiencia utilizando alguna de las siguientes disciplinas para responder preguntas de negocio o científicas: estadística, matemáticas, machine learning, econometría, inferencia causal, modelización Monte Carlo, entre otras.
Experiencia trabajando con R y/o Python.
Conocimientos y experiencia en SQL.


Filosofía de compensación

Ofrecemos un paquete integral de remuneración y beneficios diseñado para seguir siendo competitivo en el mercado, apoyar tu bienestar y reconocer tu contribución a nuestro éxito. Nuestro enfoque se basa en una filosofía de remuneración por desempeño, recompensando el impacto individual. Tu paquete de compensación específico se determinará en función de factores como tus habilidades, experiencia, cualificaciones y ubicación.

Dependiendo de tu puesto y ubicación, podrás optar a bonificaciones e incentivos anuales, beneficios de salud y bienestar, tiempo libre remunerado, planes de jubilación, cobertura de seguros y otros beneficios locales o establecidos por la legislación aplicable.

Los detalles específicos sobre la compensación y los beneficios para este puesto se tratarán durante el proceso de selección.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Clarivate is looking to expand its data science team with a talented Senior Data Scientist to join us in Europe, on a hybrid model, from our Barcelona Office.

If you're passionate about shaping the future of knowledge search and discovery, we'd love to have you on board!

By working with us, you'll have the opportunity to develop cutting-edge machine learning and AI models to enhance the user experience of customers in the intellectual property & science domains. Our ultimate goal? Empowering researchers and professionals to unlock the full potential of their work, discover new insights and make a lasting impact on the world.

About You – Experience, Education, Skills, And Accomplishments


Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
At least 5 years of professional experience in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing, Data Science, or a related technical field, including the delivery of AI/ML/NLP solutions in production environments.
At least 3 years of hands-on experience across the machine learning lifecycle, including data acquisition, preprocessing, feature engineering, model development, validation, deployment, monitoring, and retraining for tasks such as classification, regression, clustering, and ranking.
At least 5 years of Python development experience, including building, testing, and deploying production-grade applications, data pipelines, or machine learning solutions.
At least 2 years of experience with cloud-based ML platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, and/or Azure) and MLOps technologies such as Docker and MLflow in enterprise or production environments.
At least 3 years of experience working in Agile software development environments, including code reviews, version control, automated testing, CI/CD practices, and delivering solutions in situations with evolving requirements and ambiguity


It would be great if you had. . . .


Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for staying current with advancements in machine learning, NLP, generative AI, and related technologies.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence decision-making across technical and non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with peers, present technical work, incorporate feedback, and drive continuous improvement.


What will you be doing in this role?


Identify strategic information needs of internal or external clients and translate these into effective, performant and impactful AI solutions.
Work in collaboration with other Data Scientists to create solutions that support professional, highly skilled decision makers in their innovation workflow.
Explore existing data for insights and recommend additional sources of data for improvements.
Perform exploratory analysis to uncover insights and identify opportunities for innovation.
Design and execute experiments to validate hypotheses and measure business impact.
Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure successful integration and deployment of solutions into production environments.
Communicate findings, recommendations, and technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences.
Contribute to the adoption of best practices in machine learning, experimentation, and model evaluation.


Product you will be developing

We are mainly using Python for model and code development, you can use whatever IDE & tools you like best (we have people using PyCharm, Databricks, Jupyter Notebook, …), model deployment is on either AWS or Google Cloud depending on the internal customer’s preference, projects are assigned on a quarterly basis but most span multiple quarters up to a year and a half. Over the past 2 decades, we’ve covered everything from UX experiments, decision support systems, search engines, information extraction, machine learning, generative AI – you name it. So the work you’ll be doing will be quite varied and allow you to expand and apply your knowledge on all the latest developments in the AI/ML/MLP domains.

About The Team

Within a larger Data Science, Search and Content team of about 100 people (of which 40+ are Data Scientists and ML Engineers), we are a team of 8 Data Scientists located in Belgium, Spain & the US that work predominantly on IP data and products (trademarks, patents and case law for both) though we do the occasional sidestep to other domains as well. We interact with Clarivate’s Product, Sales, Marketing and Operations divisions on a regular basis to make sure we deliver optimal internal and external customer value. With multiple Principal Data Scientists in the team, we can offer excellent support to help you grow in your role. Also, while a lot of work we do originates from customer requests, we also do a fair share of explorative and POC work to help our internal customers understand the business value of the latest technologies.

Hours of Work

This is a permanent full-time contract, we work regular CET hours in Europe, in a hybrid model, with flexibility to accommodate a healthy work-life balance.

At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non-discrimination in all locations.
