Title: Junior Healthcare Data Analyst
HTML:
Learn About Knok

At knok, we dare to lead and humanise the digital transformation of healthcare. We envision a world where everyone has timely access to quality healthcare through digital technology, creating a more equal society. We genuinely believe in it, and you can recognise it in every person who embraces this mission.

Through a Digital Front Door strategy, knok connects patients, providers and healthcare professionals in one place. Our API-first white-label platform enables a continuous, engaging and personalised healthcare experience for all conditions through a cutting-edge Patient Journey Engine.

With regular clinical practice as our main source of knowledge, we leverage ready-to-use data to improve care automation and increase financial savings. Since 2015, we have enabled more than 2.5 million clinical interactions in over 12 countries. Our platform is scalable and AI-ready, enhancing the power of data-driven care to deliver better outcomes during all stages of life.

Are you ready to join us in revolutionising healthcare and making a tangible impact on people's lives?

About The Role

We are looking for a Junior Healthcare Data Analyst to support our teams in turning complex healthcare data into meaningful insights. You'll be working with datasets from different sources, such as clinical operations, insurance processing, and patient journeys - helping us improve care delivery and decision-making.

If you're passionate about using data to make healthcare more accessible and effective, don't stop here - dive deeper!

As an Junior Healthcare Data Analyst, you will:

  • Collect, clean, and analyse healthcare data from multiple sources (e.g. EHR, patient demographics, operational systems), to extract meaningful insights;
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualisations to communicate key metrics and findings to stakeholders, including clinicians, operational teams and leadership team;
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with teams across the organisation, including data science, product management, and clinical operations, to support data-driven decision-making;
  • Perform statistical analysis to support population health management, risk stratification, and clinical outcome optimisation;
  • Contribute to improving data quality by identifying data quality issues and anomalies, and work with relevant stakeholders to address and resolve them

What Makes You a Great Fit For This Journey

  • Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Medical Statistics, Biomedical Sciences, Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Health Informatics, or a related field. Master's degree preferred;
  • Experience (academic or professional) with data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Power BI or similar;
  • Technical expertise regarding data models, database design development, data mining and segmentation techniques;
  • Ability to turn complex data into clear insights that support better decision-making;
  • Knowledge of programming languages such as Python or R for data analysis and statistical modeling;
  • Ability to explain a dashboard or an analysis to someone without a technical background, in a simple and practical way;
  • Care when working with data to ensure accuracy, consistency and reliability;
  • Ability to manage several analytical tasks at the same time, prioritising what has the greatest impact on the business and patients

Nice to have:

  • Experience with SQL;
  • Experience with Apache Superset;
  • Previous experience or exposure to the healthcare sector

Recruitment stages

  • People Interview: A conversation to get to know you better, explore your background and motivation, and introduce you to knok, our culture, and the role.
  • Case Study: A practical exercise designed to understand how you approach data, structure your analysis, and turn information into meaningful insights.
  • Final Interview: A conversation with the Hiring Manager where you'll present your case study, explain your reasoning, and discuss your approach in more detail

Title: Risk - Data Analyst
Description:
About The Job


As a Data Analyst, you will join the RISK Commercial, Personal Banking and Services (CPBS) Analytics Platform, created in 2021 and part of the RISK CPBS Head Office teams. To support both RISK and the Business in monitoring the credit risk detection process, the Analytics Platform delivers services within the DERIK tool through a set of dynamic dashboards. These dashboards are mainly designed to facilitate the monitoring of alerts raised by detection tools, as well as the monitoring of portfolio quality. The most advanced technologies and methodologies available (Dataiku, Tableau) are leveraged to deliver high value‑added services while maintaining an excellent level of quality


Your Main Activities Are


Developments for data integration in the Data Transformation Mapping (DTM)
Building of the indicators of the DERIK CPBS tool, using the DATAIKU tool
Building of the dashboards for final users, using the TABLEAU tool
Technical documentation
Follow up of the processing chains
Force of proposal for functional enhancements, ergonomic improvements, and performance optimisations for the DERIK CPBS tool
Participation in the assessing of the quality of the data and the provided services
Conducting of dedicated analysis on specific topics and/or situations
Develop data integration processes in the DTM of the DERIK CPBS tool, based on the specifications, using the DATAIKU tool
Manage deliveries in production, after the testing phase validation
Perform the needed historical data loading
Write the technical documentation
Attend the expression of needs workshops (new needs, evolution of existing dashboards,...)
Based on the functional specifications, namely to develop the views for business indicator calculations in line with data visualisation needs, using the DATAIKU tool, and to build the dashboards for the final users, using the TABLEAU tool
Manage deliveries in production, after the testing phase validation
Ensure the functional testing phase of the dashboards before their release
Write the technical documentation of the views and of the dashboards
Ensure the follow up of the processing chains and the resolution of the incidents
Participate in the assessment of the quality of the data and the provided services
Conduct dedicated analysis on specific topics and/or situations
Be proactive in proposing functional enhancements, ergonomic improvements, and performance optimisations for the DERIK CPBS tool
Be able to propose and implement innovative methods and/or algorithms (for example, based on artificial intelligence)

Knowledge of data preparation and data visualisation
Knowledge and Awareness of Credit Risk

DATAIKU, TABLEAU, SQL
Organisational capacity
Rigour
Analytical capability

Adaptability

Ability to solve issues

As a Data & Analytics Engineer, you will bridge the gap between data engineering and business intelligence. You will design and develop robust data pipelines, structure data in Google BigQuery and create the semantic and visualisation layers that make data accessible to business users.

At b.telligent, you will work on challenging customer projects across different industries, collaborate closely with experienced data and analytics specialists, and help organisations build modern, data-driven solutions.

In this role, you will closely work with and be an integral part of our partner company emnos for which you will deliver the services described here within.

emnos is part of the b.telligent network

emnos is a global leading provider of an Al-based Retail Analytics B2B platform for retailers and their suppliers. It enables emnos to globally support joint, data-driven optimization of decisions in Category Management and Retail Media, mainly driven from clients’ consumer experience. The platform focuses on secure and efficient exchange of information and analysis between retailers and their suppliers, creating new business opportunities and revenue streams.

Your responsibilities


Design, develop and maintain reliable ETL and ELT pipelines using Python, SQL and Airflow or Google Cloud Composer
Build and optimise scalable data models in Google BigQuery
Apply data-modelling concepts such as star schemas, snowflake schemas and dimensional modelling
Develop data transformations and analytics-ready datasets for downstream consumption
Translate complex data structures into intuitive semantic layers and visualisations
Create dashboards and reports with Looker, Yellowfin or comparable BI tools
Work closely with customers and business stakeholders to understand requirements and define relevant KPIs
Turn business requirements into practical analytics solutions and actionable insights
Contribute to the continuous improvement of data architectures, engineering standards and best practices
Use Databricks and Apache Spark where appropriate for advanced data processing and lakehouse scenarios
Document technical solutions, data models and operational processes

Professional experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, business intelligence or a comparable role
Strong knowledge of Python and advanced SQL skills
Practical experience developing ETL and ELT pipelines
Experience with Apache Airflow or Google Cloud Composer
Hands-on experience with Google BigQuery and modern data-warehousing concepts
Knowledge of data modelling, including star and snowflake schemas

Familiarity with dbt or similar transformation frameworks is an advantage

Title: Research Grant
Description:
Research Opportunities

Energy




Work description

Develop AI solutions for the analysis and forecasting of energy data.
Create data lake structures for the integration of industrial data.
Model consumption, renewable generation, storage, and CO2 emissions.
Test the models in scenarios applied to the ceramics industry.
Prepare a technical report and a scientific paper.




Academic Qualifications

Master's in electrical engineering or similar.




Minimum profile required

Experience in Python programming.
Knowledge of data analysis, Artificial Intelligence, or machine learning.
Knowledge of energy systems and modelling of energy resources.




Preference factors

Fluency in English and Portuguese, spoken and written.
Experience in data analysis, Artificial Intelligence, or machine learning.
Experience in data integration, processing, and structuring.
Knowledge of energy systems, renewable generation, storage, and CO2 emissions.




Maintenance stipend: € 1359.64, according to the table of monthly maintenance stipend for FCT grants, paid via bank transfer. Grant holders may be awarded potential supplements, according to a quarterly evaluation process (Articles 19, 21 and 22 of the Regulations for Grants of INESC TEC and Annex II), up to a maximum limit of 50% of the monthly maintenance stipend.




INESC TEC supports costs with registration, enrolment or tuition fees, during the grant duration, under the terms established in the internal document: Payment of Tuition fees to grant holders.




The grant holder will benefit from health insurance, supported by INESC TEC.




Application Period

From 03 Sep 2026 to 03 Oct 2026




Centre

Power and Energy Systems




Scientific Advisor

Filipe Joel Soares

Multicultural and collaborative environment
A multicultural, international and collaborative environment that makes it easier to exchange ideas, work in networks and create synergies.
International projects
The possibility of working in international projects with some of the most important companies in the field.
Mentoring
Mentoring with the best researchers in the fields of electrical and industrial engineering, bioengineering, information technology and physics.
Self Improvement
The possibility of participating in international conferences, workshops, seminars and vocational training.
Other Benefits and Perks
Flexible working time, health insurance, discounts in hotels, transportation, etc.

Title: Data & AI Lead (M/F) - Híbrido (Porto)
HTML:
🚀Oportunidade:

Com mais de 25 anos de experiência no setor tecnológico, a Ankix destaca-se pela sua abordagem próxima, combinando estratégia orientada, inovação contínua e uma adaptação ágil às exigências do mercado.


Mais do que especialistas em tecnologia, somos uma comunidade de talento e colaboração, onde a confiança e a partilha de conhecimento são a base do nosso crescimento. Aqui, evoluir é um compromisso real, vivido todos os dias.


Estamos à procura de quem queira fazer a diferença. Se tens ambição, talento e vontade de crescer num ambiente que estimula o teu potencial, a Ankix é o lugar para ti. Aceitas o desafio?


Estamos a recrutar o seguinte perfil:

Data & AI Lead (M/F) - Híbrido (Porto)


🎯O perfil que procuramos:

  • Formação académica na área de Tecnologias da Informação ou semelhante;
  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em Data, Analytics, BI ou Engenharia de Dados;
  • Experiência comprovada na liderança de equipas técnicas e/ou multidisciplinares;
  • Capacidade para definir estratégias de dados alinhadas com objetivos de negócio;
  • Experiência na gestão de stakeholders e coordenação entre equipas técnicas e de negócio;
  • Experiência na gestão e priorização de roadmaps de dados e analytics;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em arquitetura de dados, modelação de dados e integração de sistemas;
  • Experiência com plataformas cloud e serviços de dados (AWS, Azure ou GCP);
  • Forte domínio de SQL e experiência com bases de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização e analytics, como Power BI, Tableau ou Looker;
  • Conhecimentos de Data Warehousing, ETL/ELT e pipelines de dados;
  • Experiência com plataformas modernas de dados, como Snowflake, Databricks ou BigQuery;
  • Conhecimentos de IA, Machine Learning ou GenAI;
  • Familiaridade com práticas de Data Governance, Data Quality e segurança de dados;
  • Fluente em inglês (C1).


💰 Intervalo salarial: €75.000 – €85.000 brutos/ano (consoante experiência) + benefícios salariais


🌍A experiência que proporcionamos:

  • Acompanhamento regular do teu Manager traz sintonia, clareza e motivação. Porque crescer com proximidade é crescer com propósito.
  • Acesso a plataformas de formação para usares consoante as tuas necessidades.
  • Comunidade ativa no WhatsApp para entreajuda técnica, partilha de conhecimento e de informação.
  • Rede de parcerias com descontos e benefícios exclusivos em saúde, bem-estar, cultura, viagens, gastronomia, lazer e muito mais.
  • Acreditamos no poder das boas conexões - recebes um prémio quando referencias um colega ou amigo.
  • Team buildings e eventos para descomprimir e celebrar.


Há lugares onde o talento faz sentido. Este é um deles!

Title: Estágio Extracurricular - Consultoria Industrial e Otimização de processos utilizando IA (f/m/div.)
Description:
O Grupo Bosch tem mais de 400 000 colaboradores em todo o mundo, presentes em 60 países, e temos orgulho em ter um impacto na vida das pessoas e em trabalhar para um futuro mais sustentável.



Desde a sua criação, a Robert Bosch, SA, com sede em Lisboa, tem orgulhosamente servido como pedra angular da presença do Grupo Bosch em Portugal. Destacamo-nos no fornecimento de serviços centrais essenciais, como Contabilidade, Compras, Comunicação, Jurídico e Marketing, estabelecendo firmemente a nossa reputação como líder em domínios críticos tais como Tecnologia da Informação e Consultoria Industrial. Para além disso, a nossa forte dedicação ao nosso bem mais valioso, as nossas pessoas, está no cerne da nossa missão.



Na Bosch, moldamos o futuro ao criarmos produtos e serviços de alta qualidade que despertam o entusiasmo e melhoram a vida das pessoas. A promessa que fazemos aos nossos colaboradores é sólida: crescemos juntos, desfrutamos do que fazemos e inspiramo-nos uns aos outros. Junta-te a nós e sente a diferença de mentalidades, culturas, gerações, identidades e perspetivas. Todos devem trazer a sua autenticidade e trabalhar juntos com respeito. A Bosch é um empregador que valoriza a diversidade e a igualdade de oportunidades. Acolhemos candidaturas de pessoas com deficiências e incapacidades, podemos providenciar adaptações razoáveis no decurso do processo de recrutamento e no desempenho da atividade profissional. A inclusão de todos e a garantia de igualdade de oportunidades permite-nos atingir o nosso verdadeiro potencial.





Descrição do emprego



Este estágio de 1 ano foca no desenvolvimento de soluções do programa de hiperautomação da Bosch Industry Consulting. 60% do tempo será dedicado à melhoria, criação e implementação das soluções e 40% ao suporte em projetos de otimização e digitalização.



As tuas principais funções serão:



Colaborar com a equipa para entender os requisitos do programa de hiperautomação e criar documentação técnica detalhada;
Explorar a LLMfarm da Bosch e soluções de no/lowcode para o desenvolvimento de sistemas de informação operacionais;
Desenvolver, testar e implementar as soluções de hiperautomação tendo em consideração os requisitos de arquitectura OT e escalabilidade;
Apoiar a equipa de consultoria industrial em projetos de otimização de processos, digitalização e resolução de problemas;
Recolher e analisar dados, e preparar relatórios e apresentações para projetos de consultoria industrial.


Qualificações



Educação: Licenciatura ou mestrado em Matemática, Ciência da Computação ou Engenharia em área relacionada;



Experiência: Experiência prévia em desenvolvimento de SW é um fator preferencial;



Know How: Habilidades de programação e bases de dados Graph; Conhecimento de processamento de linguagem natural e RPA-Ai;



Línguas: Bom conhecimento de inglês, tanto oral como escrito;



Estilo e Métodos de Trabalho: Excelente capacidade de análise, aprendizagem e resolução de problemas. Capacidade de gerir o tempo de forma eficaz e priorizar tarefas de forma autónoma com foco no resultado.



Personalidade: Iniciativa, resiliência e capacidade de trabalhar em equipa e melhorar continuamente.





Informação adicional



Work inclui:



⚖️ Condições de trabalho flexíveis



🔀 Sistema de trabalho híbrido



🌐 Partilha de experiências com colegas de todo o mundo



📚 Oportunidades de formação (p.e., formação técnica, formação em línguas estrangeiras) & certificações



📈 Oportunidades para progressão de carreira e desenvolvimento profissional contínuo



🅿️ Parque de estacionamento gratuito



🍽️ Cantina







Histórias de sucesso não acontecem por acaso...



Faz com que aconteçam. Candidata-te!

Title: Business Data Analyst
Description:
Sobre a Empresa




A Solverde.pt é uma marca portuguesa de jogo online. Desde o seu lançamento em Setembro de 2017, temos vindo a trabalhar todos os dias para oferecer o melhor produto de jogo online do país.




Sobre a Função




Procuramos um(a) Data & Business Analyst altamente qualificado(a) para integrar a nossa equipa.

A função irá apoiar a performance, reporting e otimização dos nossos produtos, com especial foco em apostas desportivas. Irá trabalhar de perto com equipas multidisciplinares para identificar oportunidades, analisar resultados e apoiar iniciativas que melhorem a experiência do utilizador e os resultados do negócio.




Responsabilidades




Recolher, analisar e interpretar grandes volumes de dados para identificar tendências, riscos e insights que apoiem a tomada de decisão.
Desenvolver e manter dashboards e relatórios para acompanhar indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) e métricas de negócio.
Colaborar com equipas multidisciplinares para identificar e definir necessidades de negócio e necessidades de dados.
Elaborar e implementar ferramentas e metodologias de análise de dados para melhorar a qualidade e a precisão da informação.
Comunicar conclusões e insights resultantes da análise de dados a stakeholders relevantes.
Monitorizar e avaliar continuamente a exatidão, integralidade e consistência dos dados.







Qualificações




Experiência prévia numa função analítica (experiência comprovada em análise de dados, análise de negócio ou área relacionada).
Forte formação académica e/ou experiência numa área quantitativa.
Fluência em inglês (oral e escrito).







Competências Requeridas







Forte capacidade analítica e de pensamento crítico, com capacidade para recolher, organizar, analisar e disseminar grandes volumes de informação.
Excelentes competências de resolução de problemas, com foco na tomada de decisão baseada em dados.
Domínio de Excel e ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI).
Experiência com SQL e Python.
Excelentes competências de comunicação, tanto oral como escrita, com capacidade para apresentar informação complexa de forma clara e acessível.
Forte atenção ao detalhe, com foco na exatidão e integralidade dos dados.
Conhecimento de produtos de sportsbook, comportamento dos jogadores e mecânicas de apostas desportivas é uma mais-valia.







Se é um(a) profissional orientado(a) por dados, com paixão por apostas desportivas e otimização de produto, esta poderá ser a oportunidade certa para ti.




Declaração de Igualdade de Oportunidades




A Solverde.pt está comprometida com a diversidade e inclusão em seu local de trabalho.

Title: Computer Vision Engineer
HTML:
A Equipa


Provavelmente não sabes, mas temos uma equipa secreta e incrível que desenvolve os nossos projetos e enfrenta desafios impressionantes e surpreendentes na área da Engenharia. Pode ser difícil acreditar, mas estão escondidos à vista de todos, acredita quando dizemos que fazem acontecer verdadeiros milagres.


Agora, estamos à procura de um Engenheiro de Visão por Computador para se juntar a esta missão e dominar a arte de interpretar o mundo através de imagens. Se és capaz de criar protótipos e testar conceitos inovadores em inteligência artificial, visão computacional e processamento de dados para resolver problemas complexos — então és a pessoa certa!



A Função


Como Engenheiro de Visão por Computador, irás:


- Criar protótipos e testar conceitos inovadores na área da inteligência artificial e da visão por computador;

- Desenvolver redes neuronais e implementar técnicas avançadas de deep learning;

- Criar algoritmos para interpretar o mundo através de imagens;

- Analisar e combinar conhecimentos de estatística, machine learning e processamento de dados para resolver problemas complexos;

- Trabalhar com processamento de nuvens de pontos e imagiologia 3D.


Estás preparado para este desafio? Então és a pessoa que procuramos!



Tu


Procuramos alguém com licenciatura em Engenharia Eletrónica (ou área relacionada) e pelo menos 2 anos de experiência prática em funções ou projetos semelhantes. É necessário ter experiência em programação, nomeadamente em C++ e Python, bem como conhecimentos de desenvolvimento orientado a objetos. Deverás sentir-te confortável a trabalhar com frameworks como TensorFlow, PyTorch ou OpenCV, assim como a utilizar bibliotecas como NumPy e Pandas.



Os teus superpoderes


- Forte familiaridade com técnicas de visão por computador e processamento de dados;

- Experiência no desenvolvimento de algoritmos para tarefas como deteção de objetos;

- Conhecimentos em aplicações de modelos de deep learning;

- Experiência no processamento de nuvens de pontos e imagens 3D;

- Autonomia;

- Capacidade para trabalhar sob elevada pressão;

- Criatividade na resolução de problemas, encontrando soluções quando outras não resultam.


Se esta descrição corresponde ao teu perfil, gostaríamos muito de te conhecer! Junta-te a nós e faz parte de uma equipa dinâmica que valoriza a inovação e a excelência!

Title: Machine Learning Engineer
Description:
Learn About Knok

At knok, we dare to lead and humanise the digital transformation of healthcare. We envision a world where everyone has timely access to quality healthcare through digital technology, creating a more equal society. We genuinely believe in it, and you can recognise it in every person who embraces this mission.

Through a Digital Front Door strategy, knok connects patients, providers and healthcare professionals in one place. Our API-first white-label platform enables a continuous, engaging and personalised healthcare experience for all conditions through a cutting-edge Patient Journey Engine.

With regular clinical practice as our main source of knowledge, we leverage ready-to-use data to improve care automation and increase financial savings. Since 2015, we have enabled more than 2.5 million clinical interactions in over 12 countries. Our platform is scalable and AI-ready, enhancing the power of data-driven care to deliver better outcomes during all stages of life.

Are you ready to join us in revolutionising healthcare and making a tangible impact on people's lives?

About The Role

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our team and build, maintain, and monitor ML-powered features that directly impact our platform and healthcare workflows. In this role, you will work closely with Data Engineering, Product, and Clinical teams to take initiatives from experimentation and evaluation through deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

You will work at the intersection of data science and software engineering deploying robust and scalable systems built on healthcare data. This role requires strong coding and system design skills, sound ML foundations, and the ability to turn ideas into production-ready features.

If this makes sense, keep reading!

As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will:


Contribute to designing, building, evaluating, shipping, and improving the product through AI/ML development
Work alongside the Product, Data and Engineering teams to implement AI/ML-powered features
Develop initiatives across the AI stack (prompt engineering, RAG, fine-tuning, agentic workflows), prototype fast, and push to production
Collaborate with Data Engineering team to develop the datasets required to build and evaluate models
Read research in the health AI space and translate research advancements into tangible product features


About You

To be considered for this role, here are the skills we're looking for:


Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field
2+ years of professional experience as a ML engineer, applied researcher, or software engineer with a focus on ML systems
Experience taking applied ML initiatives from early experimentation and prototyping through evaluation, deployment, and iteration in production
Strong foundations in machine learning, including generative AI
Experience deploying ML/AI services in a cloud environment
Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders


Nice to have:


Track record of building and deploying production-grade software in healthcare
Experience with model training and observability platforms (e.g., Vertex AI, SageMaker, WandB, MLFlow, LangSmith, Langfuse)
Experience with vector databases (e.g., ChromaDB, Pinecone)
Experience working with analytical databases (BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake)


Recruitment stages


People Interview: A conversation to get to know you better, explore your background and motivation, and introduce you to knok, our culture, and the role
Hiring Manager Interview: A short conversation with the Hiring Manager to discuss your data science background, research approach, technical experience, and problem-solving mindset
Case Study: A practical exercise designed to understand how you structure a problem, approach model evaluation, and balance research with production readiness
Final Interview: A conversation with the Hiring Manager and a member of our Senior Leadership Team, where you'll present and discuss your case study, explain your technical decisions, and explore your approach to collaboration, ownership, and impact


We know that great candidates don't always fit a rigid checklist. If you don't meet every single requirement but are passionate about AI and healthcare, we strongly encourage you to apply!

Title: Business Intelligence /Data Analytics Engineer Trainee (IEFP)
Description:
Join us as a Business Intelligence /Data Analytics Engineer Trainee!

As a Business Intelligence /Data analytics Engineer Trainee you will design, build, and maintain scalable analytics solutions that transform raw data into actionable insights. You will work closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, and analysts to deliver reliable data models, dashboards, and reporting solutions that support strategic and operational decision-making.

Key Accountabilities

You will primarily be responsible for:


Assist in collecting, cleaning, transforming, and validating data from multiple sources.
Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends, anomalies, and business insights.
Develop and evaluate machine learning models for supervised and unsupervised learning tasks.
Prepare datasets for statistical analysis and predictive modelling.
Stay current with emerging technologies, tools, and best practices in data engineering, analytics, and data science.
Designing and maintaining semantic data models (star/snowflake schemas) optimized for analytics and reporting.
Building and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines from multiple data sources, ensuring data quality and consistency.
Ensure data quality, consistency and performance across business intelligence solutions.
Developing and maintaining dashboards and reports using BI tools such as Power BI, Python and R.
Translating business requirements into robust BI solutions and flexible Power BI semantic models.
Optimizing SQL queries, data models and report performance for large-scale datasets, monitoring BI workloads in cloud and on-premises environments.
Collaborating with business users to understand KPIs, metrics and reporting needs, and partnering with Data Engineers, Data Scientists and Product teams.
Providing guidance and best practices to analysts and report developers.
Defining and enforcing data standards, naming conventions and documentation, supporting data lineage and metadata management.
Ensuring compliance with security and privacy requirements.


Knowledge, Skills And Experience Required


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering or related fields.
Eligible for an IEFP Level VI Internship.
Good programming skills; knowledge of python, C#.
Machine learning model development and evaluation.
Data wrangling using libraries such as Pandas/Modin, Polars, NumPy.
Knowledge of multiple databases such as SQLServer, PostgreSQL, DuckDB.
API-based data ingestion.
Strong SQL skills and experience with data warehouses (e.g. Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Big Query, Redshift, SQL Server).
Hands-on with Power BI (semantic models, DAX, DirectQuery) and ETL/ELT tools (SSIS, ADF, Airflow, dbt, SSIS or similar).
Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric and Azure Foundry (Nice to have).
Knowledge of data modelling techniques (Kimball, dimensional modelling).
Analytical mindset with the ability to translate business needs into data models and KPIs.
Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Organized, able to manage multiple priorities and share knowledge effectively.
Fluent in English, with good verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills.
Nice to have: experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS), Python, DevOps/CI-CD for BI, data governance frameworks.

Title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
Description:
Make a measurable and mission-critical impact.

Bring your unique talents and experience to a leading company in Industrial IoT (IIoT) solutions. Grow your passion into a rewarding profession by joining a dynamic and expanding organization. You’ll play a vital role that supports your success and helps drive safe, efficient, and reliable operations across industries worldwide.

Where you’ll work: This is a hybrid role based out of our Porto office. In practice, most of your work can be done remotely, with occasional in-office time in Porto for team collaboration — a flexibility our engineers consistently tell us they value.

Job Duties And Responsibilities

You will own machine learning solutions end to end — from framing the business problem to running models reliably in production — built on real-time telemetry from industrial IoT sensors deployed around the world.

Collaborate for success


Own machine learning projects end to end: plan the roadmap, frame the problem, build the pipelines, and take solutions through to production.
Translate business goals into ML solutions, and explain results, limitations and uncertainty to business stakeholders in terms they can act on.
Make the technical decisions, contribute significantly to the implementation, and mentor other engineers through code review and design discussion. This is a hands-on role.


Build ML-powered solutions


Deliver forecasting, classification and anomaly detection on time series from industrial IoT sensors reporting in real time from sites across the globe.
Work with the realities of sensor data: gaps, drift, scarce labels, and a device population that keeps evolving.
Run what you build — monitoring, drift detection and retraining — and shape the data pipelines your models depend on.


Engineer with AI assistance


Use agentic coding tools — Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor and similar — as a normal part of daily delivery.
Hold AI-generated code to the same bar as any other code. You are accountable for what you ship.
Structure repositories, tests and documentation so both people and agents can work in them effectively, and share the patterns and guardrails that work so the team's baseline rises.
Apply Anova's AI Handbook guidance on model risk and human-in-the-loop validation to any model whose output reaches a customer or drives an automated action.


Advocate for quality

Contribute to and continuously adapt best practices and Ways of Working across data engineering, machine learning and MLOps, so the team ships high-quality solutions that create real impact for our clients.

Minimum Requirements -


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field or equivalent combination of education and experience
5+ years of experience in machine learning engineering or a closely related software engineering role, including hands-on production deployment (6–8 years preferred).
Hands-on experience delivering production-level, cloud-native machine learning solutions.
Strong Python and the engineering habits that go with it: git, code review, linters, unit tests and CI/CD pipelines are things you use daily.
Strong understanding of feature engineering, ML algorithms, model training and evaluation.
Solid experience across a modern ML stack: gradient boosting (LightGBM, XGBoost), scikit-learn, PyTorch, MLflow, and current time series tooling.
Experience operating models in production: deployment, monitoring, drift detection and retraining, and a feel for the MLOps practices that make that sustainable.
Fluency with agentic coding tools.
Fluent in written and spoken English.


Preferred Qualifications -


Depth in the Azure Databricks platform: PySpark, MLflow, streaming pipelines.
Experience implementing agentic workflows in production.
Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar patterns for exposing models as tools other agents can call directly.
Domain experience in industrial, energy or IoT settings.

Title: Lead Data Consultant
Description:
Company Description

Hitachi Solutions Europe is a global Digital, Data and Technology consultancy, Microsoft Solution Partner and Cloud Services partner, specialising in end-to-end transformation.

As a global consultancy company working across the private and public sectors, we specialise in Dynamics 365 Business Applications, Power Platform, including Azure, Application Modernisation and Data & Analytics.

Our highly skilled team help drive improvements, creating efficiency and growth within organisations. We are committed to Microsoft technologies, with a mission to revolutionise modern businesses.

To achieve this we employ the best, most dedicated talent to deliver outstanding technology solutions to both our local and global clients.

Be part of our Hitachi family

We place value on collaboration, open communication, and transparency. We emphasise the importance of team spirit, cohesion, and appreciation. Through our talented people, innovative culture, and technical and business expertise, we deliver game changing outcomes every day. Our learning culture and flat hierarchy are our recipes for success.

Job Description

We are looking for a Lead Data Consultant to join us on our exciting journey and be part of our Hitachi Solutions family.

This is a unique and challenging opportunity for an experienced Analytics Consultant to join the Data, Analytics & AI practice of Hitachi Solutions Portugal.

In this role you will be providing bespoke and cutting-edge data and advanced analytics solutions, bringing significant commercial advantage to some of Europe’s most recognised companies.

The successful candidate will draw upon their experience with data engineering and business intelligence tools and techniques to advise clients on data and analytics best practices and deliver data and analytics solutions on time and to budget.

The Main Areas Of Responsibility Are


Provide expert advisory services to clients on advanced analytics and data engineering best practices, ensuring delivery of scalable and efficient solutions.
Lead teams and projects, supporting all aspects of delivery from requirements gathering to solution design and implementation.
Capture client requirements and lead the development of solution architectures that meet both current and future business needs.
Design and develop bespoke Data Platform, Business Intelligence and Advanced Analytics solutions, leveraging the latest cloud technologies.
Lead the design, implementation, and optimisation of enterprise data engineering solutions on Microsoft Fabric and Azure Databricks, delivering robust, secure, and scalable data products that support analytics, reporting, and AI use cases.
Build and oversee the development of dynamic, interactive reports and dashboards using Power BI, ensuring clear, actionable insights for clients.
Guide teams in data modelling and transformation efforts, ensuring the development of optimised data architectures, including the design of ETL/ELT pipelines.
Mentor and guide junior team members, sharing knowledge and best practices to support their professional development.
Actively contribute to the development of the team in Portugal, ensuring close ties to the rest of the European team.


Qualifications

We are looking to hire ambitious consulting professionals who combine their technical acumen with a genuine enthusiasm for improving organisations:


10+ years of experience designing and delivering cloud-based Data Engineering, Analytics, and AI solutions, ideally within a consulting or systems integration environment.
Extensive experience in a client-facing role, previously working for a consultancy or systems integrator, with a proven track record of leading teams or projects.
Hands-on experience with modern programming languages such as Python and SQL.
Familiarity with data integration tools like Azure Data Factory and Data platform solutions such as Microsoft Fabric and/or Databricks.
Expertise in data visualisation and analytics using Power BI, QlikView or Tableau.
Strong experience in data modelling and transformation, including the design of ETL/ELT processes and data warehousing solutions
Experience or awareness of Big Data and Data Science and/or AI technologies, including the integration of Machine Learning models and/or Generative AI components.
Experience in leading, mentoring, and developing Data & Analytics teams, with a passion for coaching and growing talent.
Demonstrated leadership within the Data Engineering and AI domain, acting as a trusted advisor to clients and internal teams.
Excellent communication, problem-solving, and client management skills.


Additional Information

Your Benefits


Flexible and friendly work environment.
Hybrid work model.
Work-life balance.
Competitive salary.
Health insurance.
25 annual leave days.
Mobile phone and public transport allowances.
Employee Assistance Programme.
Pension Plan.


Beware of scams

Our recruiting team may communicate with candidates via our @hitachisolutions.com domain email address and/or via our SmartRecruiters (Applicant Tracking System) [email protected] domain email address regarding your application and interview requests.

All offers will originate from our @hitachisolutions.com domain email address. If you receive an offer or information from someone purporting to be an employee of Hitachi Solutions from any other domain, it may not be legitimate.

Title: Business Data Analyst (Maintenance)
Description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us:

SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long-term, asset-backed business model that delivers high-availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower-carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy.

Purpose



As a Business Data Analyst, you analyze and interpret complex data to provide actionable insights that support business decision-making and strategy development. Work closely with stakeholders to identify data needs, create reports, and develop data models that drive business performance and optimize operational efficiency. Ensure data accuracy and contribute to the continuous improvement of data processes and tools.



Responsibilities



Analyze and interpret complex data sets to provide actionable insights that support business decision-making and strategy development.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify business needs and data requirements, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and objectives.
Develop and maintain data models, dashboards, and reports, providing clear and concise visualizations that communicate key findings to stakeholders.
Ensure data accuracy and integrity by performing data validation, cleansing, and quality checks, maintaining high standards of data governance.
Extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from various sources into analytical tools, ensuring data is prepared and structured for analysis.
Identify trends, patterns, and anomalies within data sets, providing insights that drive business process improvements and operational efficiency.
Support the development and implementation of data-driven strategies, working closely with business units to optimize performance and achieve key objectives.
Present findings and recommendations to senior management and stakeholders, translating complex data insights into understandable and actionable business terms.
Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in data analytics, integrating new tools and methodologies to enhance analytical capabilities.
Provide training and support to team members and other departments on data analysis techniques and the use of analytical tools, fostering a data-driven culture within the organization.



Education



Bachelor's degree in data science, business analytics, computer science, statistics, or a related field is required. Certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) are highly recommended. Proficiency in data analysis, statistical tools, and business intelligence (BI) platforms is essential. A master’s degree in a related field is preferred but not mandatory.



Experience



Minimum of 5 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related field, with demonstrated expertise in analyzing business data to support decision-making processes.
Proven experience in collecting, cleaning, and analyzing large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that drive business performance.
Strong technical background with hands-on experience in using data analysis tools and languages such as SQL, Python, R, or Excel, and proficiency in business intelligence platforms like Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik.
Demonstrated ability to develop and implement data models, reports, and dashboards that provide actionable insights to stakeholders across the organization.
Experience in working closely with business units to understand their data needs, translating business requirements into data-driven solutions that support strategic goals.
Proficiency in data visualization techniques, with the ability to present complex data in a clear and compelling manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Knowledge of data governance, data quality management, and best practices for ensuring data integrity and accuracy across systems.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify data-related issues and recommend effective solutions to improve business processes.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including IT, finance, and operations, to support data-driven initiatives.
Relevant certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) are preferred.



Functional Competencies

Compliance

Governance, Risk and Control

Analytics and reporting

IT Tools and application

Cost and budget control

Business Partnering

Digital savvy

Business Acumen

Contract Management

Management of change application

GENERAL INFORMATION

It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group (“the Company”). For further information, please visit our website at www.sbmoffshore.com. The companies in which SBM Offshore N.V., directly and indirectly, owns investments are separate entities.

SBM Offshore is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. SBM Offshore does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

HTML:
A Equipa


Provavelmente não sabes, mas temos uma equipa secreta e incrível que desenvolve os nossos projetos e enfrenta desafios impressionantes e surpreendentes na área da Engenharia. Pode ser difícil acreditar, mas estão escondidos à vista de todos, acredita quando dizemos que fazem acontecer verdadeiros milagres.


Agora, estamos à procura de um Engenheiro de Visão por Computador para se juntar a esta missão e dominar a arte de interpretar o mundo através de imagens. Se és capaz de criar protótipos e testar conceitos inovadores em inteligência artificial, visão computacional e processamento de dados para resolver problemas complexos — então és a pessoa certa!



A Função


Como Engenheiro de Visão por Computador, irás:


- Criar protótipos e testar conceitos inovadores na área da inteligência artificial e da visão por computador;

- Desenvolver redes neuronais e implementar técnicas avançadas de deep learning;

- Criar algoritmos para interpretar o mundo através de imagens;

- Analisar e combinar conhecimentos de estatística, machine learning e processamento de dados para resolver problemas complexos;

- Trabalhar com processamento de nuvens de pontos e imagiologia 3D.


Estás preparado para este desafio? Então és a pessoa que procuramos!



Tu


Procuramos alguém com licenciatura em Engenharia Eletrónica (ou área relacionada) e pelo menos 2 anos de experiência prática em funções ou projetos semelhantes. É necessário ter experiência em programação, nomeadamente em C++ e Python, bem como conhecimentos de desenvolvimento orientado a objetos. Deverás sentir-te confortável a trabalhar com frameworks como TensorFlow, PyTorch ou OpenCV, assim como a utilizar bibliotecas como NumPy e Pandas.



Os teus superpoderes


- Forte familiaridade com técnicas de visão por computador e processamento de dados;

- Experiência no desenvolvimento de algoritmos para tarefas como deteção de objetos;

- Conhecimentos em aplicações de modelos de deep learning;

- Experiência no processamento de nuvens de pontos e imagens 3D;

- Autonomia;

- Capacidade para trabalhar sob elevada pressão;

- Criatividade na resolução de problemas, encontrando soluções quando outras não resultam.


Se esta descrição corresponde ao teu perfil, gostaríamos muito de te conhecer! Junta-te a nós e faz parte de uma equipa dinâmica que valoriza a inovação e a excelência!
